name: cacheguard
description: Claude-CacheGuard: price a send into a big idle chat, offer a clean new worker, remember what was learned, share the memory between computers.

language.title: Language / Язык / Мова
language.description: Language of the mod and of its texts for the model: en (English), ru (русский), uk (українська).

compression.title: Memory compression
compression.description: How much the memory the mod gives the model (recall, recall_more, the quotes of a handoff) is squeezed, without any model: off; lite (spaces, markup); full (+ function words); ultra (+ punctuation and capitals). Code, paths, links, numbers and names are never touched.

syncDir.title: Sync folder
syncDir.description: A folder on the network share that every computer of yours reaches, for example \\NAS\share\cacheguard or Z:\cacheguard; create it once. Each computer writes only into its own subfolder. Empty: no sync.

bandMinTokens.title: Band: from how many context tokens
bandMinTokens.description: The band with the price of a send appears when the chat holds more tokens than this (and enough minutes have passed).

bandIdleMinutes.title: Band: how many minutes after a reply
bandIdleMinutes.description: The band appears when more minutes than this have passed since the last reply. The cache lives 60 minutes.

showLimits.title: Band: show the limit percentages
showLimits.description: Add a line with the used percentages of the limits (5 hours, week) to the band.

python.title: Python command
python.description: The command the mod runs its Python scripts with.

embedModel.title: Embedding model
embedModel.description: The Ollama model of the vector search in the memory (ollama pull <name>). On a change every vector is computed again.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.description: Bring the project's lessons (past errors and what they taught) back where they fit: beside an owner's message close to one (hidden, at most 2, each once a chat) and as a one-time stop before a command that holds a lesson's trigger. Off: lessons are still saved and recall still finds them.

lessonsMinScore.title: Lessons: how close a message must be
lessonsMinScore.description: The similarity (0 to 1) of a message and a lesson from which the lesson is shown. Higher: fewer lessons, surer ones.
